trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: State the intent to get a refund for a past booking.
steps.text: నమస్కారం, నేను కొన్ని నెలల క్రితం booking చేశాను. నా డబ్బులు వాపస్ కావాలి.
steps.clean_text: నమస్కారం, నేను కొన్ని నెలల క్రితం booking చేశాను. నా డబ్బులు వాపస్ కావాలి.
steps.model_visible_text: నమస్కారం, నేను కొన్ని నెలల క్రితం booking చేశాను. నా డబ్బులు వాపస్ కావాలి.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the request and ask for the lead ID to proceed.
steps.expected_behavior: Ask for the lead ID to look up the booking.
steps.text: నమస్కారం. మీ బుకింగ్ క్యాన్సిల్ చేసి refund తీసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా? దయచేసి మీ lead ID చెప్పగలరా?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent needs the lead ID to fetch booking details before proceeding with any refund query.

steps.purpose: Provide the lead ID.
Fetch booking details using the provided lead ID.
steps.expected_behavior: Call lookup_booking with the extracted lead ID.
steps.planner_rationale: The user provided the lead ID, so the agent looks up the booking to find the reference number and status.

steps.purpose: Return the booking details.
Ask for a verification factor before discussing sensitive booking details.
steps.expected_behavior: Request the user's name for identity verification.
steps.text: ధన్యవాదాలు. సెక్యూరిటీ కోసం, దయచేసి మీ పేరు చెప్పగలరా?
steps.planner_rationale: Before disclosing refund eligibility or booking specifics, the agent must verify the caller's identity.

steps.purpose: Provide the registered name.
Verify the provided name.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity with the registered_name factor.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent checks if the provided name matches the account records.

steps.purpose: Return a failed verification result.
Inform the user of the failed verification and ask for an alternative factor.
steps.expected_behavior: Prompt for a different verification factor like pincode or date of birth.
steps.text: క్షమించండి, పేరు మ్యాచ్ అవ్వలేదు. దయచేసి మీ registered pincode లేదా date of birth చెప్పగలరా?
steps.planner_rationale: Since the name verification failed, the agent must ask for another valid factor to authenticate the user.

steps.purpose: Provide the pincode with an STT error.
Verify the provided pincode.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity with registered_pincode despite the STT error.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent correctly interprets 'ప్యాన్ కోడ్ 500081' as the 6-digit pincode requested in the previous turn.

steps.purpose: Return a successful verification result.
Confirm verification and state the intent to check refund eligibility.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge successful verification and transition to checking eligibility.
steps.text: ధన్యవాదాలు, మీ వివరాలు మ్యాచ్ అయ్యాయి. మీ బుకింగ్ BK-9002, మీరు 500000 రూపాయలు కట్టారు. నేను refund eligibility చెక్ చేస్తాను.
steps.planner_rationale: With identity verified, the agent can now safely discuss the booking reference and proceed to check the refund policy.

steps.purpose: Check the refund eligibility for the booking.
steps.expected_behavior: Call check_refund_eligibility using the booking reference.
steps.planner_rationale: The business rules require checking eligibility before discussing or initiating any refund.

steps.purpose: Return the refund eligibility status.

result.reason: Cancellation of confirmed allotment outside window

steps.purpose: Inform the user that they are not eligible for a refund and explain why.
steps.expected_behavior: State the refund ineligibility, the reason (confirmed allotment, time passed), and ground the response in the tool output.
steps.text: నేను చెక్ చేశాను. మీ refund కు eligibility లేదు. మీ allotment 'confirmed' అయింది మరియు మీరు డబ్బులు కట్టి 140 రోజులు దాటినందున, agreement ప్రకారం డబ్బులు వాపస్ రావు.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must clearly communicate the mandatory details of why the refund is denied based on the eligibility tool's reason and lookup details.

steps.purpose: Ask for clarification on domain terminology.
steps.text: Allotment confirmed అంటే ఏమిటి? నాకు అర్థం కాలేదు. దయచేసి మామూలు మాటల్లో చెప్పండి.
steps.clean_text: Allotment confirmed అంటే ఏమిటి? నాకు అర్థం కాలేదు. దయచేసి మామూలు మాటల్లో చెప్పండి.
steps.model_visible_text: Allotment confirmed అంటే ఏమిటి? నాకు అర్థం కాలేదు. దయచేసి మామూలు మాటల్లో చెప్పండి.

steps.purpose: Explain the domain term in simple words and state the deduction amount.
steps.expected_behavior: Explain 'confirmed allotment' simply, referencing the specific unit ID and the exact deduction amount from the tool.
steps.text: Allotment confirmed అంటే మీకు B-0803 అనే ఫ్లాట్ పూర్తిగా కేటాయించబడింది. ఇలా కేటాయించిన తర్వాత క్యాన్సిల్ చేస్తే, agreement ప్రకారం మీరు కట్టిన 500000 రూపాయలు deduction కింద పోతాయి.
steps.planner_rationale: The user has low digital literacy and needs plain language. The agent grounds the explanation using the unit ID and deduction amount from previous tool results.

steps.purpose: Repeat the agent's statement to confirm understanding.
steps.text: అంటే నేను కట్టిన 500000 మొత్తం deduction కింద పోతుందా? నాకు సున్నా రూపాయలు వస్తాయా?
steps.clean_text: అంటే నేను కట్టిన 500000 మొత్తం deduction కింద పోతుందా? నాకు సున్నా రూపాయలు వస్తాయా?
steps.model_visible_text: అంటే నేను కట్టిన 500000 మొత్తం deduction కింద పోతుందా? నాకు సున్నా రూపాయలు వస్తాయా?

steps.purpose: Confirm the user's understanding of the deduction and zero refund.
steps.expected_behavior: Confirm that the refundable amount is exactly zero as returned by the tool.
steps.text: అవునండి, మీరు కట్టిన 500000 రూపాయలు పూర్తిగా deduction అవుతుంది. మీకు refund గా సున్నా రూపాయలు వస్తాయి.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent validates the user's understanding, ensuring the deduction truth rule is upheld without making any false promises.

steps.purpose: Accept the resolution and end the conversation.
steps.text: సరే, అర్థమైంది. నేను agreement మళ్ళీ చదువుకుంటాను.
steps.clean_text: సరే, అర్థమైంది. నేను agreement మళ్ళీ చదువుకుంటాను.
steps.model_visible_text: సరే, అర్థమైంది. నేను agreement మళ్ళీ చదువుకుంటాను.
